_comment: The OpenStax books Bio Map quotes (step 09) and takes figures from (step 10), each pinned to the last commit OpenStax published under CC BY 4.0. OpenStax relicensed both books to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 in two steps: the repository LICENSE on 2026-03-19 and the books' own metadata on 2026-04-23. Copies released under CC BY stay CC BY; steps 09 and 10 check both declarations at the pinned commit.
